      AI Insights

       Info

      Dimensions summary

      This listing bills by usage across several security functions. Workload protection comes in size bands (Essentials, Small, Medium, Large, NotCloud), letting you match pricing to workload scale. File Storage Security and Conformity each offer three size bands (Small, Med, Large). Cloud Sentry is a separate option. One dimension charges per gigabyte inspected, so cost tracks data volume. Most dimensions carry an end-of-sale date in 2025, meaning they are no longer available for new purchase after those dates. The per-gigabyte inspected option has no listed end-of-sale date.

      Top-of-mind questions for buyers

      How does the per-gigabyte inspected dimension calculate my cost?
      This dimension meters the volume of data scanned, measured in gigabytes. Your cost tracks the amount of data inspected, so it rises and falls with scanning activity. Unlike the size-band options, there is no fixed band; you pay for the actual gigabytes processed.
      What do the Workload size bands like Small, Medium, and Large represent?
      Each Workload band matches a workload scale tier. You pick the band that fits your protected workload size and pay by units within that band. The NotCloud band applies to workloads outside cloud environments, such as physical or on-premises servers.
      Can I still buy these dimensions after their listed end-of-sale dates?
      Most dimensions carry a 2025 end-of-sale date and are no longer available for new purchase after those dates. Workload and Cloud Sentry end October 1 and September 30, File Storage Security September 30, and Conformity July 31, 2025. The per-gigabyte inspected option has no listed end-of-sale date.

      Delivery details

      Software as a Service (SaaS)

      SaaS delivers cloud-based software applications directly to customers over the internet. You can access these applications through a subscription model. You will pay recurring monthly usage fees through your AWS bill, while AWS handles deployment and infrastructure management, ensuring scalability, reliability, and seamless integration with other AWS services.

      reviewer2793894

      Centralized cloud view has improved threat response and simplified compliance reporting

      Reviewed on Dec 29, 2025
      Review from a verified AWS customer

      What is our primary use case?

      The main use case for Trend Vision One - Cloud Security is to secure our cloud environment from threats and we had to also abide by compliances, which is why we procured cloud security from Trend Micro.

      What is most valuable?

      We are using Trend Vision One - Cloud Security for getting complete visibility of all the assets that exist within our cloud, and it helps us identify any sort of misconfigurations or fine-tuning that can be done to better our compliance.

      Trend Vision One - Cloud Security helps in onboarding all the cloud solutions or cloud providers that we have within our organization into a single dashboard, thereby providing greater visibility of all the assets.

      Earlier we used to have multiple dashboards to manage the same solution or capability, but with Trend Micro, we are able to get everything in a single pane of glass, benefiting our operations significantly.

      We are using the playbooks built into Trend Vision One - Cloud Security, which help us take a lot of response actions and bring automation capabilities into play.

      Trend Vision One - Cloud Security has positively impacted our organization by providing a single pane of glass visibility across all the cloud solutions that we have and reducing the number of threats we used to see earlier in the cloud.

      We are seeing that the number of cloud operations required earlier in terms of threat detection and response, and the time taken to detect a particular threat and take a response action, has considerably improved after onboarding Trend Micro.

      What needs improvement?

      I would like to see more third-party integrations being added into Trend Vision One - Cloud Security, as it currently has a good amount of integrations but does not allow ingestion from many third-party solutions.

      We would like to see the reports being more granular and actionable in Trend Vision One - Cloud Security; for example, if there is a particular dashboard view that an analyst is viewing, we would like the ability to export that data into a report or send it via email, as those kinds of automations are currently missing.

      For how long have I used the solution?

      We have been using Trend Vision One - Cloud Security for two and a half years.

      What's my experience with pricing, setup cost, and licensing?

      The pricing for Trend Vision One - Cloud Security is very straightforward; we are using credits for calculating the solution that is required, and in terms of setup cost and licensing, it is very flexible.

      The thirty-day free trial credits available for doing a pilot of the solution really helped us evaluate Trend Vision One - Cloud Security, so I would suggest that if you are planning to evaluate, you can try out the free trial that is available.

      What other advice do I have?

      We did not purchase Trend Vision One - Cloud Security through AWS Marketplace. I would rate this solution nine out of ten.

      Which deployment model are you using for this solution?

      Public Cloud

      If public cloud, private cloud, or hybrid cloud, which cloud provider do you use?

      Amazon Web Services (AWS)

      Hybrid Cloud Security :Unified Protection with Powerful Feature.

      Reviewed on Oct 19, 2025

      What do you like best about the product?
      What I appreciate most about Hybrid Cloud Security is how it delivers unified protection for both on-premises and cloud environments. It maintains consistent security policies, offers real-time threat detection, and provides seamless visibility, which greatly simplifies managing data protection and compliance.
      What do you dislike about the product?
      One drawback of Hybrid Cloud Security is the complexity involved in configuring and managing multiple environments. It can require significant expertise to ensure seamless integration and consistent policy enforcement across different platforms.
      What problems is the product solving and how is that benefiting you?
      Hybrid Cloud Security solves the challenge of protecting data and applications across both on-premises and cloud infrastructures. It provides centralized visibility, threat detection, and policy management, ensuring consistent security standards. This helps maintain compliance, reduce vulnerabilities, and enhance overall operational efficiency.
